title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-17
lineage: Aud > mastercassette > DAT > CDR > EAC > Flac-level8
source: FOB-Nak 700's > Sony D5  recorded by Barry Glassberg

ai_review.summary: Hand‑held audience recording captures a high‑energy 1982 show with a killer Shakedown Street and soaring Spanish Jam, though the mix leaves Phil’s bass a bit low.
ai_review.review: The performance is highlighted by an incendiary second set – Shakedown Street, Spanish Jam, Space, Uncle John’s Band, Not Fade Away and Baby Blue all receive glowing praise – and the overall energy is described as “top‑shelf” and “killer.” The handheld FOB recording delivers good punch and clarity, but a few reviewers note that Phil’s bass sits low in the mix, preventing a perfectly balanced sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and highlight strong musical moments; recording is generally praised as good with only minor mix issues, yielding a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hand‑held FOB captures solid punch and clarity; occasional imbalance (Phil’s bass low in the mix) but overall clean and listenable.

poor_songs: Lost Sailor > Saint of Circumstance (mixed reception)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is uneven and middle‑of‑the‑road, but the second set erupts with tight jams and seamless transitions; the show builds to a high point with Shakedown Street and the extended Spanish/Space sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar is described as clean, full of plucking/plunking, overtone licks and strong vocal delivery; he drives the jams with enthusiasm.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass presence is noted as low in the mix, though his percussive jamming moments are appreciated when heard.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocals are praised for being solid and well‑blended, especially on Bird Song and the second‑set numbers.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s piano/keyboard work shines – tasty blues runs, Spanish jam leads, and a standout piano sound on Uncle John’s Band.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drummers keep a steady groove throughout, providing reliable support for the jams.
